hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to encourage standing in prayer during Ramadan without commanding them with firmness, and he would say: 'Whoever stands in Ramadan with faith and seeking reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away and the matter remained like that, and the matter continued like that during the caliphate of Abu Bakr and the beginning of the caliphate of Umar upon that.

potential_issues.issue: Al-Zuhri is classified as Category 3 mudallis by Ibn Hajar and uses indirect transmission term 'an (عَنِ) in both chains
potential_issues.impact: Al-Zuhri is generally considered extremely reliable despite his tadlis. His tadlis is well-documented but his overall reliability and precision make his narrations acceptable even with 'an according to majority of scholars. This does not significantly impact authenticity.

potential_issues.issue: Multiple ambiguous transmission terms ('an, anna) in both chains
potential_issues.impact: The presence of indirect terms reduces the strength slightly from 'Perfect' to 'Sound' or 'Acceptable', but the overall reliability of all narrators (especially having both Ma'mar and Malik narrating from al-Zuhri) strengthens the narration significantly.

potential_issues.issue: Hadith narrated through two separate chains (Ma'mar and Malik) from al-Zuhri
potential_issues.impact: This strengthens the hadith as it shows multiple reliable transmission paths. Both Ma'mar and Malik are highly reliable narrators from al-Zuhri.

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ /94 مَعْمَرٍ L7633 /94 ، /94 وَمَالِكٌ L6659 /94 ، عَنِ /26 الزُّهْرِيِّ L7272 /26 ، عَنْ /26 أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ L4903 /26 ، /27 عَنْ /93 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ L4396 /93 ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يُرَغِّبُ فِي قِيَامِ رَمَضَانَ ، مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُمْ بِعَزِيمَةٍ ، وَيَقُولُ : /20 مَنْ قَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ " /27 ، فَتُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَالأَمْرُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ، ثُمَّ كَانَ الأَمْرُ كَذَلِكَ فِي خِلافَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ، وَصَدْرًا مِنْ خِلافَةِ عُمَرَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ
